# StyleSeed Provenance

This audit workflow selectively adapts StyleSeed's separation of fixed judgment, output grammar, surface constraints, project decisions, code inspection, and rendered-pixel verification. It also adapts the evidence/confidence/counterexample/transfer-test structure for reference-derived design rules.

Owen Wiki does not vendor StyleSeed's components, skins, design-language corpus, score threshold, or 20-skill engine. Existing Owen UI Foundation contracts and executable Playwright/axe gates remain authoritative.
